conflicts.description: Previous spec increased MCP timeout from 15s to 30s for K8s latency. Our spec reduces it from 30s to 10s for better UX. This may cause template registration timeouts on slow networks.

evidence.commit: 71f61e97 - Pass 4: Implement searchSimilarActivities stub and increase MCP timeout
evidence.comment: // Increased from 15s to 30s for Pass 4 to prevent timeouts during template registration

conflicts.impact: Template registration to backend may timeout if K8s network latency > 10s

resolution.rationale: 10s timeout is sufficient for most networks. K8s latency issues should be solved at infrastructure level (not by increasing timeouts). Circuit breaker prevents cascading failures. Enhanced error messages help diagnose network issues.
mitigation: Circuit breaker prevents repeated attempts to slow backend
Enhanced error messages guide user to check network connectivity
registerTemplate has separate 30s timeout with progress feedback (not affected by DEFAULT_TIMEOUT)
K8s network latency should be < 5s with proper configuration
resolution.action: MONITOR - Track template registration failures in production

conflicts.description: ensure_initialized now returns status dict instead of void. Tool handlers that call this method must be updated to handle the new return value.
conflicts.impact: Any MCP tool handler in metabob-cli that calls ensure_initialized needs to check return value and handle 'initializing' status

resolution.rationale: Breaking change is intentional and necessary to eliminate 60s blocking wait. Provides better UX.

requiredUpdates.change: Update tool handlers to check ensure_initialized status before executing
requiredUpdates.pattern: status = await state_change.ensure_initialized(); if status['status'] == 'initializing': return error_response('Server initializing, retry in a few seconds')

requiredUpdates.change: Same pattern - check status before template operations

resolution.action: REQUIRED - Update all tool handlers that call ensure_initialized

conflicts.description: Both specs enforce using MCP for template loading. No conflict - reinforces same architectural pattern.

evidence.bootstrapSpec: Enforces embedded templates for bootstrap, MCP for non-bootstrap
evidence.timeoutSpec: Reduces MCP timeout from 30s to 10s for all operations including template loading

conflicts.impact: Bootstrap template fallback remains functional. 10s timeout applies to non-bootstrap template loading via MCP.

resolution.rationale: Both specs enforce same architecture (MCP for templates). Timeout reduction improves UX without breaking functionality.

recommendation.details: Track MCP tool failures in production. If template registration fails due to K8s latency, consider per-operation timeout overrides (e.g., registerTemplate keeps 30s while other ops use 10s).
All tool handlers must check return value: if status == 'initializing', return early with retry message. This is a breaking change that requires code updates across metabob-cli.
